content.caption: Line chart of average benchmark accuracy for four models with no skills or with skills evolved by EvoSkill, SkillOpt and WikiSkill. WikiSkill is highest for every model, and its lead grows for stronger models.
content.description: This is a line chart with a categorical x-axis listing four models from left to right: Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.6-27B and Gemini 3.5 Flash. The y-axis is 'Accuracy (%)', which the page context describes as average accuracy across the evaluated benchmarks. The y-axis does not start at zero. Its labelled ticks are 30%, 45%, 60% and 75%, each with a light dashed horizontal gridline, and the plot extends slightly below 30%. A legend below the plot identifies four series: No skill (blue line, circle markers), EvoSkill (green line, square markers), SkillOpt (orange line, triangle markers) and WikiSkill (yellow line, diamond markers). No data values are printed on the chart, so all numbers below are estimated read-offs against the gridlines. Values are listed in the order Qwen3.5-4B / Qwen3.5-9B / Qwen3.6-27B / Gemini 3.5 Flash. No skill: ~26.3 / 30.0 / 39.5 / 49.5. EvoSkill: ~33.8 / 42.4 / 53.4 / 56.3. SkillOpt: ~35.2 / 40.3 / 50.8 / 56.0. WikiSkill: ~38.6 / 47.5 / 63.4 / 68.2. Every series rises monotonically from the smallest model to Gemini 3.5 Flash. WikiSkill is the top line at every model, and No skill is the bottom line at every model. SkillOpt starts slightly above EvoSkill at Qwen3.5-4B, but the green and orange lines cross shortly to the right of Qwen3.5-4B. EvoSkill then stays above SkillOpt at Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-27B. At Gemini 3.5 Flash the two converge at about 56% with overlapping markers, EvoSkill marginally higher. EvoSkill flattens between Qwen3.6-27B and Gemini 3.5 Flash (about +3 points). WikiSkill's lead over the best baseline widens from about 3 points at Qwen3.5-4B to about 5 at Qwen3.5-9B, 10 at Qwen3.6-27B and 12 at Gemini 3.5 Flash. Its steepest rise is between Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-27B (about +16 points). The No skill line rises only about 4 points from Qwen3.5-4B to Qwen3.5-9B, then by roughly 10 points per step. With any skill method, Qwen3.5-9B (~40-48%) matches or exceeds No-skill Qwen3.6-27B (~39.5%). WikiSkill on Qwen3.6-27B (~63%) is well above No-skill Gemini 3.5 Flash (~49.5%).
